turns.replyText:
Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular floors are Fika (from our Icons collection) and High Five (from our Rebels collection):
• Fika ($10.39/sq ft) is a classic Scandinavian white oak floor with a traditional 3-layer engineered wood construction. It features a matte finish, can be sanded up to two times over its lifetime, and can be floated, stapled, or glued down.
• High Five ($5.59/sq ft) is part of our Rebels collection—the most durable hardwood floors in the world. It features a real wood veneer fused to a moisture-resistant core, making it waterproof, 3 to 5 times stronger than traditional hardwood, and ideal for heavy wear and tear.
If you prioritize maximum durability, pet/kid resistance, and the best value for your budget, High Five is the better choice for you. If you prefer a traditional plank structure that can be sanded down the line, Fika is a beautiful classic option.
